last_session.text: Trout recruited Squints, a newly arrived halfling, as junior assistant in his Halfling Corps. Trout later put the rescued Brother Dirk under Squints.
The party caught Naggeneen, the invisible Clurichen stealing Quinn's booze, and handed him over to Quinn.
Dunk spotted a glowing magical mithril chain shirt in Warwick the smith's shop and told the party he had a plan to get it.
Dunk struck a deal with Ingrid the Alchemist for a sleeping potion. He got wine from the fauns and gave her a watered-down batch.
George the woodsman described the dragon's deadly powers and lair, and doubted the Reeve can pay the bounty.
The party set out for Sir Brandon's Barrow Mound after Father William pointed them to the sword buried there.
Squints pulled Brother Dirk from a sleeping giant's sack, and the party outran the waking giant across a field.

open.text: Acquire the mithril chain shirt from Warwick the smith's shop.
Find the treasure marked on the party's treasure map.
Kill the black dragon and drag its body into Brandonsford to collect Eric the Reeve's 1000 gold.
Fight Eric the Reeve in the dawn duel Sir Phidipaldi challenged him to.
Get Farmer Gill's mule Shamus.
George says nothing pierces the dragon's black scales. Its poisonous bite kills, and it spits sulfur.
Farmer Gill won't lower his price for Shamus until his boys return, since he can't work without them or a mule.
Farmer Gill says Warwick always refuses to sell his mithril chain shirt.
The party holds a treasure map marking several unrecognized locations near Brandonsford.
If Dunk helps Ingrid get her sleeping potion to Warwick, he could get into Warwick's house to take the shirt.
If Dunk meets Ingrid tonight, he can collect her sleeping potion and use it to put Warwick to sleep.
Father William says that if the party goes to Sir Brandon's Barrow Mound, they can retrieve the sword buried with him.
George says the dragon's lair lies north at the foot of the mountains, with no climbing needed.
If the party claims Sir Brandon's sword, they gain what is said to be the only way to kill the dragon.
If the party checks a marked map location on its way north through the forest, they could find the map's treasure.
If the party pays Lady Hilda, she will fight the dragon alongside them.
Squints has joined the party as Trout's junior assistant, taking orders directly from Trout.
Dunk says that if the party gets Warwick's mithril chain shirt, it could help them against the dragon.
If the party hires Lady Hilda, they gain a seasoned fighter in chain mail with a shield.
Dunk says that if the party gets Warwick's mithril chain shirt, they will have magical armor.
If the party pays Drop Dead Ned 100 gold a week, he and his killer wasp will do anything that lets him kill people.
Why are the once-hidden fairies coming out more often?
Where did this new dragon come from?
Why has nothing reached Brandonsford in months?
Dunk must help Ingrid get into Warwick's house and give him her sleeping potion, in return for her brewing it.
Dr. Uriah must do penance at the Barrow Mound and give Father William 10 gold for its upkeep.
Trout must let Squints pick from the Halfling Corps' first treasure after the elite members. Until then, Squints pays his own way.
Sir Phidipaldi must bring his lance against the dragon, as he vowed to George.
Sir Phidipaldi must come back for Lady Hilda's services after the party talks to the Reeve.
The black dragon that tore off George's arm is still at large around Brandonsford and may maim others.
George says the dragon can't fly yet but soon will, and then they are doomed.
A slow giant in the cyclopean cottage captures people to eat, and Brother Dirk says he meant to stew him. The giant is now awake and chased the party.
